introBody: Geisha Fusion brings the world's favourite dishes under one roof. Classic favourites with a modern twist — burgers, curries, pasta, fresh pizza and a proper Sunday roast — served in a lively, welcoming dining room in Benton.

marks.p: open from midday, seven days a week — lunch specials, mains and Sunday roast.
family-friendly tables, a proper kids menu, and an allergy menu on hand.
American burgers, mouth-watering curries, pastas and stone-baked pizza.

menuSub: A taste of the kitchen. See the full lists — plus the special menu, kids menu, drinks and allergy guide — on the menus page.
storyBody1: Geisha Fusion is the family-friendly side of Geisha. The idea was simple: bring the dishes people actually love most — wherever in the world they come from — together under one roof, and serve them in a warm, lively room you can walk into any day of the week.
storyBody2: From a quick lunch special to a bottomless brunch, a Sunday roast with the family or a birthday in our VIP function room, there's a table here for the occasion.
